name: engineering-business-public-advisory-fixtures
dataBoundary: Fully de-identified public fixtures derived from advisory document shapes. Customer names, people, locations, dates, amounts, document numbers, and project facts are synthetic.
sourceBoundary: Source signals preserve document type, structural shape, and AIOS routing need only. Private provenance is kept under ignored .local-docs and must not be copied into public fixtures.

syntheticDataPolicy.purpose: Keep realistic extraction fields while preventing leakage of customer identities, contacts, locations, dates, amounts, and raw source text.
syntheticDataPolicy.inputFormat: Markdown-normalized fixtures. Raw PDF, DOCX, image, and PPT parsing are tested separately from prompt behavior.
